8101.commentary: (THa) mānuso'pi ca bhavo'bhirādhito'ti manuss'attabhāvo'pi mayā tādisena kusalakammunā samavāyena abhirādhito sādhito adhigato. kāṇakacchap'opama-suttam'ettha udāharitabbaṃ.

examples.text: mānuso'pi ca bhavo-abhirādhito, saggakāyam'agamaṃ sakiṃ sakiṃ, rūpadhātusu arūpadhātusu, n'evasaññisu asaññisuṭṭhitaṃ.

8105.meaning1: wished for; liked; pleasing; agreeable; highly prized

examples.text: bhavati parijan'assavo vidheyyo, mah'imaṃ āvasito susaṅgahito, piyavadū hitasukhataṃ jigīsamāno, abhirucitāni guṇāni ācarati.
mayūra-koñca-abhirutamhi kānane, dīpīhi byagghehi purakkhato vasaṃ, kāye apekkhaṃ jaha mā virādhaya, itissu maṃ citta pure niyuñjasi.

8108.commentary: (JAa) mayūrakoñc'ābhirudan'ti ubhosu tīresu vanaghaṭāyaṃ vasantehi mayūrehi ca koñcehi ca abhirudaṃ upakūjitaṃ.

examples.text: mayūrakoñca-abhirude, kokil'ābhinikūjite, khattiyānaṃ kule bhadde, kiṃ nu sukhataraṃ tato.

8109.meaning1: (of a horse, elephant, or vehicle) ascending (onto); climbing aboard; mounting
8109.commentary: (SNPa) brahmalokasaṅkhātaṃ devalokaṃ yāpetuṃ samatthattā devalokayānasaññitaṃ aṭṭhasamāpattiyānaṃ abhiruyha (VVa) puna abhiruyhā'ti ettha anunāsikalopo daṭṭhabbo, abhiruyhaṃ ārohanīyan'ti vuttaṃ hoti.

examples.text: devayānaṃ abhiruyha, virajaṃ so mahāpathaṃ, kāmarāgaṃ virājetvā, brahmalok'ūpago ahu, na naṃ jāti nivāresi, brahmalok'ūpapattiyā.

atha kho, āvuso, rājā pasenadi kosalo sāvatthiyā nikkhamitvā antepuradvārā paṭhamaṃ rathavinītaṃ abhiruheyya, paṭhamena rathavinītena dutiyaṃ rathavinītaṃ pāpuṇeyya, paṭhamaṃ rathavinītaṃ vissajjeyya dutiyaṃ rathavinītaṃ abhiruheyya.
yo pana bhikkhu bhikkhuniyā saddhiṃ saṃvidhāya ekaṃ nāvaṃ abhiruheyya uddhaṃgāminiṃ vā adhogāminiṃ vā aññatra tiriyaṃ taraṇāya, pācittiyaṃ.
tesaṃ kho pana, bhikkhu, caturāsītiyā assasahassānaṃ eko'y'eva so asso hoti yam'ahaṃ tena samayena abhiruhāmi, valāhako assarājā.
sudhotarajapacchadaṃ subhaṃ, goṇakatūlikasanthataṃ navaṃ, abhiruha sayanaṃ mah'ārahaṃ, candanamaṇḍita-sāragandhikaṃ.
tatth'āyaṃ samayo, gilānasamayo, cīvaradānasamayo, cīvarakārasamayo, addhānagamanasamayo, nāvā-abhiruhana-samayo, mahāsamayo, samaṇabhattasamayo, ayaṃ tattha samayo.
ahaṃ middhena pakato, vihārā upanikkhamiṃ, caṅkamaṃ abhiruhanto, tatth'eva papatiṃ chamā.

yathā hi pākatikaratho akkhe vā anabbhañjite atirekesu vā manussesu abhiruḷhesu kūjati viravati, na evaṃ ariyamaggo. so hi ekappahārena caturāsītiyā'pi pāṇasahassesu abhiruhantesu na kūjati na viravati. tasmā akūjano'ti vutto.

atha khv'āhaṃ sāvatthiyā nikkhamitvā antepuradvārā paṭhamaṃ rathavinītaṃ abhiruhiṃ. paṭhamena rathavinītena dutiyaṃ rathavinītaṃ pāpuṇiṃ, paṭhamaṃ rathavinītaṃ vissajjiṃ dutiyaṃ rathavinītaṃ abhiruhiṃ.

8116.meaning2: should be climbed up; to be ascended

8118.meaning1: having climbed up; having climbed on top (of)

examples.text: tena kho pana samayena, rañño ambo dhuvaphalo hoti. atha kho, bhikkhave, so chapako yena so ambo ten'upasaṅkami, upasaṅkamitvā taṃ ambaṃ abhiruhitvā nilīno acchi.
atha kho, bhikkhave, lāpo sakuṇo naṅgalakaṭṭhakaraṇaṃ leḍḍuṭṭhānaṃ gantvā mahantaṃ leḍḍuṃ abhiruhitvā sakuṇagghiṃ vadamāno aṭṭhāsi, ehi kho dāni me, sakuṇagghi, ehi kho dāni me, sakuṇagghī'ti.

8119.meaning1: having ascended; having mounted; having boarded

examples.text: atha kho vesālikā licchavī bhadrāni bhadrāni yānāni yojāpetvā bhadraṃ bhadraṃ yānaṃ abhiruhitvā bhadrehi bhadrehi yānehi vesāliyā niyyāsuṃ bhagavantaṃ dassanāya.

seyyathā'pi, bhikkhave, subhūmiyaṃ catumahāpathe ājaññaratho yutto assa ṭhito odhastapatodo. tam'enaṃ dakkho yogg'ācariyo assadammasārathi abhiruhitvā, vāmena hatthena rasmiyo gahetvā, dakkhiṇena hatthena patodaṃ gahetvā, yen'icchakaṃ yadicchakaṃ sāreyya'pi paccāsāreyya'pi.

8120.meaning1: (of a vehicle or ship) ascended; mounted; boarded

examples.text: bhikkhuniyā abhiruḷhe bhikkhu abhiruhati, āpatti pācittiyassa. bhikkhumhi abhiruḷhe bhikkhunī abhiruhati, āpatti pācittiyassa. ubho vā abhiruhanti, āpatti pācittiyassa.

yathā hi pākatikaratho akkhe vā anabbhañjite atirekesu vā manussesu abhiruḷhesu kūjati viravati, na evaṃ ariyamaggo. so hi ekappahārena caturāsītiyā'pi pāṇasahassesu abhiruhantesu na kūjati na viravati. tasmā akūjano'ti vutto.

8121.meaning1: beautiful; handsome; lovely; of fine form
8121.synonym: kalyāṇa, kallāṇa, cāru, rūpavant, vaggu, sudassana, sundarika, suvaṇṇa

examples.text: so suṇeyya cakkhumato bhāsamānassa, chekaṃ vata, bho, odātaṃ vatthaṃ abhirūpaṃ nimmalaṃ sucī'ti! so odātapariyesanaṃ careyya.
apissu taṃ jano disvā evam'āha, abhirūpo vata, bho, rañño nāgo, dassanīyo vata, bho, rañño nāgo, pāsādiko vata, bho, rañño nāgo, kāy'upapanno vata, bho, rañño nāgo'ti!
yathā yathā kho, assalāyana, satta brāhmaṇ'isayo asitaṃ devalaṃ isiṃ abhisapiṃsu tathā tathā asito devalo isi abhirūpataro c'eva hoti dassanīyataro ca pāsādikataro ca.
taṃ kiṃ maññasi, nanda, katamā nu kho abhirūpatarā vā dassanīyatarā vā pāsādikatarā vā, sākiyānī vā janapadakalyāṇī, imāni vā pañca accharāsatāni kakuṭapādānī'ti?
dantaṃ nayanti samitiṃ, dantaṃ rājā-abhirūhati, danto seṭṭho manussesu, yo'tivākyaṃ titikkhati.
tatth'āyaṃ samayo, gilānasamayo, cīvaradānasamayo, cīvarakārasamayo, addhānagamanasamayo, nāvā-abhirūhanasamayo, mahāsamayo, samaṇabhattasamayo, ayaṃ tattha samayo.

8128.meaning2: causes to rise; plants; puts on, fixes on, fastens (especially on a stupa), presents as an offering

8130.meaning1: puts on; bedecks oneself (with); decorates oneself (with); dresses up (in)
8130.commentary: (THIa) abhiropehī'ti maṇḍanavibhūsanavasena vā sarīraṃ āropaya, alaṅ'karohī'ti attho.

examples.text: kāsikasukhumāni dhāraya, abhiropehi ca mālavaṇṇakaṃ, kañcanamaṇimuttakaṃ bahuṃ, vividhaṃ ābharaṇaṃ karomi te.

8131.commentary: (MNa) abhilakkhitā'ti ettha upasaggamattam'eva, tasmā abhilakkhitā'ti lakkhaṇīyā icc'eva attho

examples.text: yaṃnūn'āhaṃ yā tā rattiyo abhiññātā abhilakkhitā… tathārūpāsu rattīsu yāni tāni ārāmacetiyāni vanacetiyāni rukkhacetiyāni bhiṃsanakāni salomahaṃsāni tathārūpesu sen'āsanesu vihareyyaṃ app'eva nām'āhaṃ bhayabheravaṃ passeyyan'ti.
ajito'ti tassa brāhmaṇassa nāmaṃ saṅkhā samaññā paññatti vohāro nāmaṃ nāmakammaṃ nāmadheyyaṃ nirutti byañjanaṃ abhilāpo'ti, icc'āyasmā ajito.
kenassu nivuto loko, kenassu nappakāsati, kissa-abhilepanaṃ brūsi, kiṃsu tassa mahabbhayaṃ.
tath'eva saddho sutavā, abhisaṅkhacca bhojanaṃ, vanibbake tappayati, annapānena paṇḍito.

8141.meaning2: planned, prepared, arranged; concocted, constructed, produced artificially; accumulated

8142.meaning1: intentionally generated; mentally manufactured; fabricated by mind

examples.text: so iti paṭisañcikkhati, idam'pi paṭhamaṃ jhānaṃ abhisaṅkhataṃ abhisañcetayitaṃ. yaṃ kho pana kiñci abhisaṅkhataṃ abhisañcetayitaṃ tadaniccaṃ nirodhadhamman'ti pajānāti.
bhante nāgasena, kiṃlakkhaṇā cetanā'ti? cetayitalakkhaṇā, mahārāja, cetanā abhisaṅkharaṇalakkhaṇā cā'ti.
atha kho āyasmā mahako tathārūpaṃ iddh'ābhisaṅkhāraṃ abhisaṅkhari yathā sītako ca vāto vāyi, abbhasampilāpo ca assa, devo ca ekam'ekaṃ phusi.

8145.meaning1: having constructed; having generated; having fabricated

examples.text: te jātisaṃvattanike'pi saṅkhāre abhisaṅkharitvā jarāsaṃvattanike'pi saṅkhāre abhisaṅkharitvā maraṇasaṃvattanike'pi saṅkhāre abhisaṅkharitvā… jātipapātam'pi papatanti
atha ca pan'idh'ekacce moghapurisā pañhaṃ abhisaṅkharitvā abhisaṅkharitvā tathāgataṃ upasaṅkamitvā pucchanti.

8146.meaning2: causes to be prepared, created; forms

examples.text: addasā kho bhagavā seṭṭhiṃ gahapatiṃ dūrato'va āgacchantaṃ, disvāna bhagavato etadahosi, yaṃnūn'āhaṃ tathārūpaṃ iddh'ābhisaṅkhāraṃ abhisaṅkhareyyaṃ yathā seṭṭhi gahapati idha nisinno idha nisinnaṃ yasaṃ kulaputtaṃ na passeyyā'ti.

8147.commentary: (MNa) pañhaṃ abhisaṅkharontī'ti dupadam'pi tipadam'pi catuppadam'pi pañhaṃ karonti.

examples.text: sāmaṃ vā taṃ, ānanda, kāyasaṅkhāraṃ abhisaṅkharoti, yaṃpaccay'āssa taṃ uppajjati ajjhattaṃ sukhadukkhaṃ. pare vā taṃ, ānanda, kāyasaṅkhāraṃ abhisaṅkharonti, yaṃpaccay'āssa taṃ uppajjati ajjhattaṃ sukhadukkhaṃ.
te suṇanti, samaṇo khalu, bho, gotamo amukaṃ nāma gāmaṃ vā nigamaṃ vā osarissatī'ti. te pañhaṃ abhisaṅkharonti, imaṃ mayaṃ pañhaṃ samaṇaṃ gotamaṃ upasaṅkamitvā pucchissāma.
yadapi, bhikkhave, lobho tadapi akusalamūlaṃ, yadapi luddho abhisaṅkharoti kāyena vācāya manasā tadapi akusalaṃ
te salle abhisaṅkharoti, te salle abhisaṅkharonto sall'ābhisaṅkhāravasena puratthimaṃ disaṃ dhāvati, pacchimaṃ disaṃ dhāvati, uttaraṃ disaṃ dhāvati, dakkhiṇaṃ disaṃ dhāvati.

8150.commentary: (MNa) vissajjane panassā pubbe ca abhisaṅkhāro'ti addhānaparicchedo vutto.

examples.text: atha kho ahaṃ, bhikkhave, tathārūpaṃ iddhi-abhisaṅkhāraṃ abhisaṅkhāsiṃ, ettāvatā brahmā ca brahmaparisā ca brahmapārisajjā ca saddañ'ca me sossanti, na ca maṃ dakkhantī'ti. antarahito imaṃ gāthaṃ abhāsiṃ.

kati pan'āvuso, paccayā animittāya cetovimuttiyā ṭhitiyā'ti? tayo kho, āvuso, paccayā animittāya cetovimuttiyā ṭhitiyā, sabbanimittānañ'ca amanasikāro, animittāya ca dhātuyā manasikāro, pubbe ca abhisaṅkhāro.

8152.meaning1: Māra in the sense of volition

examples.text: atha kho āyasmā mahāmoggallāno tathārūpaṃ iddh'ābhisaṅkhāraṃ abhisaṅkhāreti yathā vejayantaṃ pāsādaṃ pād'aṅguṭṭhakena saṅkampesi sampakampesi sampavedhesi.
atha kho āyasmā mahāmoggallāno tathārūpaṃ iddh'ābhisaṅkhāraṃ abhisaṅkhāresi yathā vejayantaṃ pāsādaṃ pād'aṅguṭṭhakena saṅkampesi sampakampesi sampavedhesi.
atha kho bhagavā tathārūpaṃ iddh'ābhisaṅkhāraṃ abhisaṅkhāsi yathā addasa uttaro māṇavo bhagavato kos'ohitaṃ vatthaguyhaṃ.

atha kho ahaṃ, bhikkhave, tathārūpaṃ iddh'ābhisaṅkhāraṃ abhisaṅkhāsiṃ, ettāvatā brahmā ca brahmaparisā ca brahmapārisajjā ca saddañ'ca me sossanti, na ca maṃ dakkhantī'ti. antarahito imaṃ gāthaṃ abhāsiṃ.

8158.meaning2: planned, prepared, arranged; concocted, constructed, produced artificially; accumulated

8161.meaning1: intense grudge-bearing; cursing; making a vendetta
8161.notes: related in meaning and form to abhisajjati

examples.text: puna caparaṃ, āvuso, bhikkhu kodhano hoti kodhahetu abhisaṅgī. yam'p'āvuso, bhikkhu kodhano hoti kodhahetu abhisaṅgī, ayam'pi dhammo dovacassakaraṇo.

8164.meaning1: is overly attached (to); is overly fond (of)

8165.meaning1: loses one's temper; curses angrily; abuses; swears; (comm) sticks

examples.text: idha, bhikkhave, ekacco puggalo kodhano hoti upāyāsabahulo, appam'pi vutto samāno abhisajjati kuppati byāpajjati patitthīyati, kopañ'ca dosañ'ca appaccayañ'ca pātukaroti.

8166.commentary: (MNa) par'ābhisajjanī'ti kuṭilakaṇṭakasākhā viya mammesu vijjhitvā paresaṃ abhisajjanī gantu'kāmānam'pi gantuṃ adatvā lagganakārī.

examples.text: pharusavāco hoti. yā sā vācā aṇḍakā kakkasā parakaṭukā para-abhisajjanī kodhasāmantā asamādhisaṃvattanikā, tathārūpiṃ vācaṃ bhāsitā hoti

8169.meaning1: lost one's temper; cursed angrily; abused; swore; (comm) stuck

examples.text: yā nūn'āhaṃ bhante, aññaṃ jātiṃ kodhanā ahosiṃ upāyāsabahulā, appam'pi vuttā samānā abhisajjiṃ kuppiṃ byāpajjiṃ patitthīyiṃ kopañ'ca dosañ'ca appaccayañ'ca pātv'ākāsiṃ, s'āhaṃ, bhante, eta'r'ahi dubbaṇṇā durūpā supāpikā dassanāya.

8170.meaning1: to lose one's temper; to get angry (about)
8170.meaning2: to lose one's temper; to curse angrily; to abuse; to swear

examples.text: sakaṃ kho pan'etaṃ, ambaṭṭha, sakyānaṃ yadidaṃ kapilavatthuṃ, n'ārahat'āyasmā ambaṭṭho imāya appamattāya abhisajjitun'ti.

so n'eva taṃ abhisaṅkharoti, na abhisañcetayati bhavāya vā vibhavāya vā. so anabhisaṅkharonto anabhisañcetayanto bhavāya vā vibhavāya vā na kiñci loke upādiyati, anupādiyaṃ na paritassati, aparitassaṃ paccattaṃ'y'eva parinibbāyati.

8172.meaning1: volitionally generated; wilfully fabricated; intentionally manufactured
8172.meaning2: involving exercise of will or volition

examples.text: so iti paṭisañcikkhati, idam'pi paṭhamaṃ jhānaṃ abhisaṅkhataṃ abhisañcetayitaṃ. yaṃ kho pana kiñci abhisaṅkhataṃ abhisañcetayitaṃ tadaniccaṃ nirodhadhamman'ti pajānāti.

8178.meaning1: ultimate extinction of consciousness; total cessation of perception; non-Buddhist trance
8178.commentary: (DNa) abhisaññānirodhe'ti ettha abhī'ti upasaggamattaṃ. saññānirodhe'ti cittanirodhe, khaṇikanirodhe kathā uppannā'ti attho.

examples.text: evaṃ vutte purimāni, bhante, divasāni purimatarāni, nānātitthiyānaṃ samaṇabrāhmaṇānaṃ kotūhalasālāya sannisinnānaṃ sannipatitānaṃ abhisaññānirodhe kathā udapādi, kathaṃ nu kho, bho, abhisaññānirodho hotī'ti?
tassa acetayato anabhisaṅkharoto tā c'eva saññā nirujjhanti, aññā ca oḷārikā saññā na uppajjanti. so nirodhaṃ phusati. evaṃ kho, poṭṭhapāda, anupubba-abhisaññānirodha-sampajāna-samāpatti hoti.

8179.meaning1: discussion about the ultimate extinction of perception
8179.meaning2: discussion about the ultimate extinction of awareness
8179.commentary: (MNt) abhisaññānirodhakathaṃ sandhāya vadati. sā'pi hi titthiyānaṃ antare pākaṭā jātā'ti.

8181.commentary: (THa) abhisatto'vā'ti tvaṃ sīghaṃ gaccha mā tiṭṭhā'ti devehi anusiṭṭho āṇatto viya. abhisaṭṭho vā'ti'pi pāṭho, tvaṃ lahuṃ gacchā'ti kenaci abhilāsāpito viyā'ti attho.

examples.text: abhisatto'va nipatati, vayo rūpaṃ aññam'iva tath'eva santaṃ, tass'eva sato avippavasato, aññass'eva sarāmi attānan'ti.
deve abhido [abhide, abhidosaṃ abhido'ti abhisaddena samān'attha-nipātapadaṃ]

8183.meaning1: truly believes (in); has total trust (in); has complete confidence (in); is completely convinced (by)

examples.text: evaṃ abhisaddahati, ime kho te dhammā ye me pubbe sutavā ahesuṃ, ten'āhaṃ eta'r'ahi kāyena ca phusitvā viharāmi, paññāya ca ativijjha passāmī'ti.

8184.meaning1: truly believing; having total trust; having complete confidence; with complete conviction (in)
8184.commentary: (THa) tassa pāpakammakārino puggalassa kiriyaṃ abhisaddahanto attā ca me hotī'ti pattiyāyanto añño'pi appapañño bālo yathā paṭipajjitvā upeti gabbhañ'ca parañ'ca lokaṃ, na tato parimuccati.

examples.text: upeti gabbhañ'ca parañ'ca lokaṃ, saṃsāram'āpajja param'parāya, tass'appapañño abhisaddahanto, upeti gabbhañ'ca parañ'ca lokaṃ.

8186.grammar: pr, caus of abhi saṃ √tap, trans (+acc)

examples.text: tassa mayhaṃ, aggivessana, dantebhi dantam'ādhāya jivhāya tāluṃ āhacca cetasā cittaṃ abhiniggaṇhato abhinippīḷayato abhisantāpayato kacchehi sedā muccanti.

8188.meaningLit: to cause to be burned extremely

examples.text: tena, bhikkhave, bhikkhunā dante'bhidantam'ādhāya jivhāya tāluṃ āhacca cetasā cittaṃ abhiniggaṇhitabbaṃ abhinippīḷetabbaṃ abhisantāpetabbaṃ.

8189.grammar: pr, caus of abhi saṃ √tap, trans (+acc)

examples.text: seyyathā'pi, bhikkhave, balavā puriso dubbalataraṃ purisaṃ sīse vā gale vā khandhe vā gahetvā abhiniggaṇheyya abhinippīḷeyya abhisantāpeyya.
tassa mayhaṃ, aggivessana, etadahosi, yaṃnūn'āhaṃ dantebhi dantam'ādhāya, jivhāya tāluṃ āhacca, cetasā cittaṃ abhiniggaṇheyyaṃ abhinippīḷeyyaṃ abhisantāpeyyan'ti.

8190.meaning2: outflow, result; lit. flow up to the end

examples.text: icc'evam accantanamassanīyaṃ, namassamāno ratanattayaṃ yaṃ, puñña-abhisandaṃ vipulaṃ alatthaṃ, tass'ānubhāvena hat'antarāyo.
ayaṃ paṭhamo puñña-abhisando kusala-abhisando sukhass'āhāro.

8192.commentary: (JAa) abhisandantī'ti sandanti pavattanti, tato tato āgantvā maṃ kosikigaṅgaṃ pavisantī'ti attho.

examples.text: nānādumagaṇ'ākiṇṇā, bahukā girikandarā, mam'eva pamukhā honti, abhisandanti pāvuse.
